title: AI Assistant
welcomeMessage: Hello! I'm your AI assistant Chuckle Chuckie. How can I help you with your power flow analysis today?
presetQuestions: Which bus has the lowest voltage on the IEEE 25-bus network?
Run a sample AC contingency analysis on the IEEE 25-bus network
placeholder: Ask me anything about power flow analysis...

responses.default: I understand your question about power flow analysis. Let me help you with that. Could you provide more specific details about what you'd like to analyze?
responses.powerFlow: Power flow analysis helps determine the steady-state operating conditions of an electrical power system. I can help you understand the results, troubleshoot convergence issues, or explain different calculation methods.
responses.convergence: Convergence issues in power flow analysis usually indicate system problems like overloaded lines, voltage violations, or incorrect system data. Let me help you identify and resolve these issues.
responses.methods: There are several power flow calculation methods: DC Power Flow (fast, approximate), AC Power Flow (accurate, slower), and Fast Decoupled (balanced approach). Which method are you using?
responses.results: Power flow results include bus voltages, line flows, and system losses. I can help you interpret these results and identify any system issues or optimization opportunities.
